support_criteria: nominal and stress net PnL and profit factor remain above zero and one in every partition
nominal and stress net excluding the largest winner remain positive in every partition
long and short attribution is reported without changing side authority
a fresh prospective shadow or micro-live lifecycle is still required because historical holdouts are no longer pristine
falsifiers: any partition fails nominal or stress expectancy
any partition depends on its largest winner
the reconstructed signal, cost, stop, hold, or funding contract differs from the source identity
the route is promoted solely from these already-viewed partitions
